title: Eve Alexandria government-index source bundle
description: Local in-process america_ask SourcesFound result. The existing shared chat/call brain synthesizes a cited answer from these sources. No America.gov-generated answer, Eve REST server or fabricated upstream endpoint.

question.description: The explicit question; omit personal identifiers, private history and attachments.

retrieved_at.description: UTC bundle-retrieval time, not a law-effective date.

sources.description: Canonical URLs deduplicated before at most three source reads; no answer field.

url.description: Canonical official HTTPS .gov/.mil URL; runtime rejects credentials, private targets, malformed URLs and nonstandard ports.

currency.description: Neither index metadata nor a live read proves current law.

excerpt.description: Bounded indexed snippet; not necessarily current.

page_text.description: Bounded successful source-page read, or empty when unavailable.

read_status.description: live denotes a successful current page read, not current-law validation. indexed_only retains the indexed excerpt when the read failed or was unsupported.

text_truncated.description: Indexed excerpt or page text was clipped to its character bound.

indexed_at.description: Provider index metadata converted to UTC, if supplied. Not a law-effective date.

fetched_at.description: UTC successful page-read time, or null without a successful read.

question.description: The explicit question; omit personal identifiers, private history and attachments.

jurisdiction.description: The U.S. state/city or U.S. federal law named by the user; null if unknown.

reason.description: Static owner-safe reason, never raw provider errors or a private question.

america_url.description: Retained legacy link, not an automatic fallback submission.

tool.name: america_ask
tool.description: Find official U.S. legal or government sources through Alexandria's government index. Returns source excerpts and available page text for a cited answer. Requires jurisdiction; source currency may be unverified. Information only, not legal advice or a filing service.

configuration.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: Existing Firecrawl credential; never forwarded to source hosts
configuration.EVE_FIRECRAWL_PER_DAY: Existing shared local-day call cap, default 5; persisted across restart

x-eve-interface.failure_behavior: Static failure without automatic retry, browser/provider fallback, catalog/planner call or provider-terms acceptance. A failed source-page read retains indexed snippet with indexed_only.
x-eve-interface.data: Only explicit question/jurisdiction enter the index query; no attachments, history or memory. Source requests carry neither provider authorization nor chat context.
